title: Pharmacy & Point-of-Sale
subtitle: Retail dispensing, inventory and supplier operations — one fast, accurate terminal

overview.lead: The Pharmacy module runs the whole retail and stock operation from a single screen: a keyboard-first point-of-sale, a live multi-batch inventory, supplier purchasing, returns, and reporting. Stock is never edited by hand — it is driven entirely by purchases, sales and returns through the database, so on-hand quantities, batch expiry and valuation always reconcile.
highlights: Keyboard-first POS with brand/generic search and automatic batch selection
Live multi-batch stock with FEFO (first-expiry-first-out) dispensing
Supplier purchasing that updates stock through a database trigger chain
Immutable stock-movement ledger for every purchase, sale and return
Purchase returns with full batch traceability and automatic reversal
Expiring-soon, dead-stock and medicine-stock reports with CSV export
Append-to-bill or collect-now settlement, integrated with the cashier
Demo shown on 117 catalogue items across 6 suppliers and 100+ batches

pos.title: Point-of-Sale terminal
pos.description: The dispensing screen is built for speed and accuracy. The cashier searches by brand or generic, the system picks the correct batch automatically (first to expire, first out), and the bill totals — discount, savings, payable — update live as items are added. One dominant payment action keeps checkout to a few keystrokes.
bullets: Search patient and medicine from the same keyboard-driven panel
Automatic FEFO batch selection — no manual batch hunting
Live Total Payable, item discount and savings as the cart changes
Cash / Card / Insurance with collect-now or append-to-bill settlement
Whole-unit and sub-unit (strip/tablet) sale support
pos.impact: A trained cashier completes a sale in seconds, with the right batch and price every time.

pos-search.title: Live medicine search
pos-search.description: Typing a brand or generic instantly filters the formulary and shows, per result, the live batch, on-hand stock, expiry date and selling price. The cashier sees exactly what is sellable before adding it — no separate stock lookup, no expired-stock surprises.
bullets: Instant brand- and generic-name matching
Per-result batch, in-stock quantity and expiry date
Selling price shown inline before adding to the bill
Out-of-stock and expired batches are kept out of the sale
pos-search.impact: Stock truth at the point of decision — the cashier never promises what isn't there.

products.title: Medicine & supply catalogue
products.description: One catalogue holds everything the clinic dispenses or consumes — medicines, syrups, injectables, IV fluids, surgical consumables and devices — each with form, strength, manufacturer and live multi-batch stock. Full-text search and category structure keep a large catalogue navigable.
bullets: Medicines and non-medicine supplies in one structured catalogue
Form, strength, manufacturer and category on every item
Live aggregated stock across all active batches
Full-text search across brand and generic names
Prescription-only and controlled-drug flags
products.impact: A single source of truth for everything on the shelves and in the store room.

purchases.title: Supplier purchasing
purchases.description: Purchases are recorded against a supplier with per-line batch number, expiry, cost and selling price. Saving a purchase writes only the purchase detail — the database trigger chain then creates or updates the batch and increments stock automatically, so receiving stock can never drift from the ledger.
bullets: Per-line batch number, expiry, unit cost and sale price
Auto-generated invoice numbers
Stock updated by the trigger chain — never edited directly
New batches created automatically; existing batches topped up
Price/expiry mismatch protection on repeat batches
purchases.impact: Goods-in is one screen, and inventory stays provably consistent with what was received.

transactions.title: Stock movement ledger
transactions.description: Every purchase, sale, return and adjustment is written as an immutable, colour-coded movement with its batch, reference and timestamp. This is the audit trail behind on-hand stock — nothing changes quantities without leaving a row here.
bullets: Purchase-in, sale-out, returns and adjustments in one ledger
Batch, supplier/reference and timestamp on every movement
Colour-coded movement types for fast scanning
Filterable by type and searchable by medicine or reference
The single explanation for any stock level
transactions.impact: Complete inventory accountability — every unit is traceable to a movement.

preturn.title: Purchase returns
preturn.description: Damaged, expired or over-ordered stock is returned to the supplier against its original batch. The return reverses stock through the same trigger chain that received it, so quantities and valuation stay correct and the movement is logged for the supplier ledger.
bullets: Return against the original supplier and batch
Automatic stock and ledger reversal
Full traceability back to the source purchase
Keeps supplier balances and valuation accurate
preturn.impact: Returns are handled cleanly without ever corrupting stock or supplier accounts.

parties.title: Suppliers & parties
parties.description: A supplier directory holds contact and tax details for every distributor the clinic buys from, each linked to its purchases and batches. Searching by name, phone or tax number makes reconciliation and reordering straightforward.
bullets: Contact, address and tax (GST) details per supplier
Linked to every purchase and batch for that party
Search by name, phone or tax number
Add or edit parties without leaving the pharmacy
parties.impact: Supplier relationships and purchase history live in one place.

reports.title: Inventory reporting
reports.description: Operational reports answer the questions a pharmacy lead asks daily: what is expiring soon, what is dead stock tying up cash, and what is the full medicine-stock position by batch. Each report expands to batch level and exports to CSV for finance or audit.
bullets: Expiring-soon watchlist to act before write-offs
Dead-stock report to free up working capital
Medicine-stock batch summary with on-hand quantities
Row-level batch drill-down
One-click CSV export
reports.impact: The pharmacy lead sees risk and opportunity without building a spreadsheet.

settings.title: Pharmacy configuration
settings.description: Receipt, tax and point-of-sale preferences are configured per clinic so the till behaves the way the business runs — from receipt content to default settlement behaviour.
bullets: Receipt and POS preferences
Tax and discount defaults
Configured per clinic
settings.impact: The terminal adapts to the clinic, not the other way around.

closing.lead: Built for real clinics, not a demo sandbox
points: Stock integrity is enforced in the database, so it holds under real-world concurrency.
Every figure on these screens is live from the running system on realistic demo data.
The pharmacy settles directly into the same billing and cashier flow used clinic-wide.
Designed keyboard-first for high-volume counters, with reporting for the people who run them.
